title: Tech Note: Extended Functionality with Object Get Coordinates and Listbox Sub Objects
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a v15-era refinement to a classic Design Mode form command (OBJECT GET COORDINATES) for listbox sub-object geometry; the command and classic listbox object model still exist in 4D today for binary/Design Mode-style forms, but form design has since evolved substantially with newer listbox and form object capabilities, and much of this pixel-coordinate-based UI scripting approach feels dated compared to more declarative form design available in later 4D versions.
related_updates: OBJECT GET COORDINATES remains available and functionally unchanged in current 4D
4D's form/listbox engine has since added further listbox enhancements
Design Mode-era form scripting patterns coexist with, but are less emphasized than, modern form object techniques
